title: Vera Wong's Unsolicited Advice for Murderers
author: Jesse Q. Sutanto
summary: Vera Wong, a nosy widow who runs a failing Chinatown tea shop, finds a dead man on the floor one morning and decides to solve the case herself, befriending the suspects who keep coming by.
readIf: you like warm, funny cozy mysteries with a meddling older heroine.
skipIf: you want a tense, procedural or dark crime story.
